notes: Planning deliverable with 32 execution cards, a standalone executor prompt, and the active continuation goal. Use the machine-readable queue and per-card proof; refresh origin/master and the revision-pinned ledger before every phase. Product code, release, deployment, publication and participant outreach remain separately authorized work. At every continuation inspect active, implemented, verified and held work before pending rows; if no card is ready, advance an authorized recovery or preparation slice instead of stopping. Never convert process, evaluator, canary or skipped-check evidence into product success.
